subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for toolProgress and commandText, and should channels.feishu.streaming remain protected from gateway config.patch?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the repair changes Feishu's public config shape and potentially a protected operator-controlled config path, so automation should not choose that product/security boundary alone.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the nested streaming preview config while preserving today's defaults and leave config.patch protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

options.title: Only soften progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu streaming boolean-only and reduce scary command text, which is smaller but still leaves no supported way to keep streaming while hiding tool progress.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Permit gateway config.patch to change channels.feishu.streaming, which helps emergency recovery but broadens the operator mutation boundary and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the nested streaming preview config while preserving today's defaults and leave config.patch protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Feishu Card Kit streaming feature and boolean config surface that this decision would extend.
